Ltd   About the role:   You’ll be working underground carrying out installs, maintenance and breakdown support across a range of mining equipment and systems.      Underground Electrician     Key Responsibilities    Perform installation, maintenance, fault finding and repair of underground electrical systems and infrastructure.  Maintain underground fixed plant including pumps, crushers, conveyors, fans, dewatering systems and ventilation equipment.  Diagnose and rectify faults on LV and HV electrical equipment to minimise production downtime.  Carry out preventative and breakdown maintenance in accordance with maintenance schedules.  Install, terminate and test power, control and communication cables.  Inspect, test and maintain motors, VSDs, switchboards, transformers and protection systems.  Complete electrical isolations, testing and commissioning of new and existing equipment.  Read and interpret electrical drawings, schematics and technical documentation.  Complete work orders and maintenance reports using the site's maintenance management system.  Ensure all work complies with Australian Standards, mine procedures and statutory regulations.  Participate in pre-start meetings, toolbox talks and safety inspections.  Maintain a strong commitment to workplace health, safety and environmental standards.  Work collaboratively with supervisors, operators and other maintenance personnel to achieve production targets.  Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to improve equipment reliability and safety.    Underground Electrical Supervisor     Key Responsibilities    Lead and supervise the underground electrical maintenance team to safely deliver daily maintenance activities.  Coordinate planned maintenance, breakdown response and shutdown activities.  Allocate work priorities to electricians and contractors to maximise equipment availability.  Provide technical leadership, mentoring and support to electrical personnel.  Ensure compliance with all statutory electrical requirements, site procedures and safety standards.  Review, approve and monitor permits, isolations and high-risk work activities.  Plan labour, equipment and materials to meet operational requirements.  Liaise closely with Underground Managers, Maintenance Planners and Operations personnel.  Monitor equipment performance and implement strategies to improve reliability and reduce downtime.  Investigate electrical failures and identify root causes and corrective actions.  Ensure accurate completion of maintenance documentation and statutory records.  Coordinate commissioning of new electrical installations and upgrades.  Conduct workplace inspections, safety observations and incident investigations.  Support continuous improvement initiatives across the maintenance department.  Promote a positive safety culture through leadership, coaching and compliance.       What you’ll need:   * Unrestricted WA Electrical Licence (essential)  * Electrical trade qualification  * Current WA C-Class manual licence (HR desirable)  * Underground mining experience (highly regarded)  * HV Switching (preferred)  * First Aid + CPR/LVR      Must be able to pass:   * Pre-employment medical  * Drug & alcohol screen  * Police clearance      Tickets that’ll help:   * Working at Heights  * Confined Space  * EWP  * Forklift  * Dogging/Rigging  * Basic Fire  * High Risk licences      What’s on offer:    Underground Electrician    Salary: AUD $178,000–$198,000 per annum plus super on all hours.    Underground Electrical Supervisor    Salary: AUD $198,000–$217,000 per annum plus super on all hours.      If you’re keen for solid rates, good roster and ongoing work in Kalgoorlie – apply now.
